authority_basis.summary: Operator explicitly named and directed the constructor-theoretic speculation as the Deutsch-Popperian Conjecture.

operations.title: The Deutsch–Popperian Conjecture for the Carrier
operations.summary: The Carrier encodes a possibility structure in which a transformation is possible only when source-derived coherent resources make it composable, repeatable, and physically readable. The conjecture is Popperian in requiring sector-independent severe falsifiers rather than retrospective analogy.

operations.title: Cross-sector constructor composition falsifier
operations.summary: For cosmology, flavor, radiative gravity, strings, and arithmetic, type substrate, task, resources, constructor, readout, and composition obstruction; reject the conjecture if no common invariant composition criterion exists.
